about: The rescue code's FORMAT (net/pairing.py, docs/SYNC-PLAN.md §2): code = 24 characters + check character Alphabet[(sum of (i+1)*index) mod 31], typos and swaps rejected. The keys, the envelope and the guard lines (salt per ID, S5 = b): docs/web/code-vectors-v2.json.
